title: Biggest of Three
goal: Write biggest(a, b, c): the largest of the three numbers.
hints: Python has a built-in for this.
Does your function need to exist at all? A name can point at max directly.

def biggest(a, b, c):
    return max(a, b, c)
socratic: What is the plainest way to do it?
Which words or spaces can disappear?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Biggest of Three”?
solution:
def biggest(a, b, c):
    return max(a, b, c)
